tools.description: Record the structured decision for the current task. Every field of the task's answer contract is required; resubmission replaces earlier values.

business_need_date.description: Documented business or clinical control date that the decision must protect (ISO date).

claimed_incidents.description: Tickets the customer listed in the claim.

controlled_item_or_record.description: Immutable item, lot set, or transaction record in scope.

credit_cap_usd.description: Cap on credits for one escalation per billing period (cap percentage of the monthly fee).

credit_per_incident_usd.description: Credit per supported breached incident (credit percentage of the monthly fee).

decision_timing_status.description: ON_TIME when the selected outcome is on or before the control date; otherwise LATE.

escalation_approval_required.description: Use 1 when an alternative is outside current authority and would need a separate approval; otherwise 0.

excluded_quantity.description: expired-promotional and other-escalation credits on the ledger

expedited_external_readiness.description: Expedited readiness date independently confirmed for the customer's accounts-payable confirmation HM-AP-51233 of standard and off-cycle application dates.

monthly_fee_usd.description: Monthly fee on the active agreement that the credit schedule is applied to.

observed_quantity.description: Gross observed quantity before applying the control for the Halcyon SLA credit claim.

outcome_vs_control_days.description: Selected outcome date minus the documented control date; positive means late.

quantity_unit.description: Unit of measure for every controlled quantity: USD.

recommended_incremental_cost_usd.description: Documented credit cost of the selected option in USD; zero when spend is not a decision driver.

recommended_option.description: Best authorized option identifier after comparing issue_net_entitlement_standard_run, issue_net_entitlement_off_cycle, pay_gross_claim_off_cycle.

recommended_outcome_date.description: Date produced by the selected option after applying every source constraint (ISO date).

source_quantity.description: USD of SLA credit entitlement for the supported resolution-time breaches under SLA-ENT-2026 and AGR-7816

standard_external_readiness.description: Standard readiness date independently confirmed for the customer's accounts-payable confirmation HM-AP-51233 of standard and off-cycle application dates.

supported_incidents.description: Claimed tickets that are in scope, not duplicates, unexempt, and measured over the SLA target.

supported_quantity.description: credits on the AGR-7816 ledger that offset ESC-3171

transaction_quantity.description: Exact quantity the primary state change may persist.

unsupported_claim_usd.description: Portion of the claim the policy does not support (claimed amount minus entitlement).
